## [1.2.3](https://github.com/RAZORRZR0/gtasa-de-morphe-patches/compare/v1.2.2...v1.2.3) (2026-11-05)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* settings files update with each patch, so renamed or removed settings no longer show stale labels (FSR showed 30 FPS) ([381a5b8](https://github.com/RAZORRZR0/gtasa-de-morphe-patches/commit/381a5b8570c7607cf39a26667f5507313dde82b6))

patches.name: Add CLEO script support
patches.description: Adds CLEO Android 2.0.1, which runs CLEO scripts with the swipe-down CLEO menu. Installs 14 GTA SA scripts in Android/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa.de/cleo/; the .csa ones, such as invincibility and regeneration, always run, so delete the ones you don't want.

patches.name: Add PS2 graphics
patches.description: Adds SkyGfx: PS2 colours and timecyc, radiosity, distant lamp coronas and post effects, the PC graphics settings the phone menu hides (draw distance, shadows, anti-aliasing and more) and AMD FSR 1 upscaling.

patches.name: Add blowing litter
patches.description: Adds Rubbish-DE by H4V3NART: loose litter on the streets that blows around when vehicles pass. Builds its model pak from the game's own files at the first start, so no game files are shipped.

patches.name: Add extra map props
patches.description: Adds about 16,000 map props from Project Props 4 by user-grinch. Downloads the placements from github.com/user-grinch/Project-Props while patching, so it needs internet.

patches.name: Add mod menu
patches.description: Adds ModMenu, an in-game menu that changes the settings of the other mods while playing.

patches.name: Fix prop physics
patches.description: Adds GTA Prop Fix, which restores the original game's physics for knocked-over props: lamp posts, traffic lights, signs, bins and hydrants fall and roll with world and car collision instead of DE's physics, and broken pieces land on the ground instead of falling through the map.

patches.name: Load pak mods
patches.description: Loads Unreal .pak mod files from Android/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa.de/paks/ when the game starts, above the game's own paks, so PC Definitive Edition pak mods work as-is. Copy the .pak files there and restart the game.

patches.name: Play loading screen music
patches.description: Plays one of the game's eight loading-screen themes while a save loads, like the PC SALoadingMusic mod.
